primaryTextChecks.text: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Ashkelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.

context.text: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.
The LORD was with Judah, and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
